The climate in Palermo

Palermo is about 32 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 9°C. Around 770 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 112 mm). The highest temperature in Palermo in 2015–2024 was 44°C (24 July 2023) and the lowest 2°C (7 January 2017).

Best time to visit Palermo

The most pleasant weather in Palermo is usually in May, June and October: average highs are between 22°C and 27°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
